title: absence-check reads example paths in a plan as declared deliverables
detail: junit-xml-evidence plan names example report paths (build/test-results/test/TEST-a.xml, target/surefire-reports/TEST-b.xml) in its test plan as fixture content written at test time. absence-check flags them as plan-declared deliverables missing from the worktree. regression-sentinel then tried to stage worktree files into the main tree to satisfy it; the reviewing writable gate denied it and drive escalated permission_denied (session d2839f08). absence-check should only count paths the plan declares as produced files (Modules touched + new), not every backtick path in the Test plan.
